tab.description: Optional tab for the order being reported. Omit to use this assignment's checkout.

outcome.description: Use placed for a merchant-confirmed order, not_placed for a confirmed failure after an order attempt, and unknown for an unresolved attempt. Leave unset if no order was attempted.

not_placed_reason.description: With outcome not_placed: the kind of failure the page shows. Omit otherwise. payment_declined: the payment was refused, including a risk or fraud decline of the payment. card_details_rejected: a card field such as number, expiry, security code or billing address was rejected as invalid. payment_verification_required: the page asks for 3-D Secure or a bank or card code. order_rejected_by_merchant: the merchant refused or cancelled the order for a reason other than payment. bot_wall: a block or access-denied page aimed at automated browsing. captcha: a bot check that could not be solved. needs_user_action: the order needs the user, such as a sign-in or a decision, other than a payment check. out_of_stock: the item is sold out or the requested slot, fare, room or listing is gone. price_changed: the price or terms changed before the order went through. site_error: the site failed with an error unrelated to payment. other: none of these fits.

confirmation.description: Optional merchant confirmation. Include its evidence and any identifier in summary; no separate copy is required.
